offering_description.value: MGP produces branded spirits for consumers and sells them mainly through beverage distributors. It distills and ages bulk spirits for other beverage companies. It also processes wheat into specialty proteins and starches for food manufacturers.

primary_products.value: Branded and bulk whiskey; vodka and other spirits; liqueurs; specialty wheat proteins; specialty wheat starches

primary_services.value: Contract distilling; barrel warehousing and aging

customer_segment.value: B2B: Beverage distributors, spirits brands and bottlers, and food manufacturers; B2C: Spirits consumers who buy directly at distillery shops

end_markets.value: Consumer spirits; beverage alcohol manufacturing; commercial baking; packaged foods; plant-based foods

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bottled spirits, bulk spirits, specialty wheat proteins and starches; project or contract: Distilling spirits to customer specifications; service fees: Storing and aging customer-owned barrels
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns grain into spirits for distributors and beverage companies, and wheat into ingredients for food manufacturers; component supplier: Supplies bulk spirits for bottling and functional wheat ingredients for food formulations; asset operator: Stores and ages customer-owned barrels in company-operated warehouses
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United States and selected international markets, including Europe

specialization.value: diversified: Branded spirits, bulk spirits and distilling services, and specialty wheat ingredients for food manufacturers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Beverage alcohol wholesalers serving retailers, bars and restaurants; direct sales: Bulk spirits and wheat ingredients sold to beverage and food manufacturers; own locations: Distillery visitor shops
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Federal TTB distilled spirits permits, state alcohol licensing, and FDA food safety requirements

notes: The current mix of operating distilleries and international markets is uncertain.
